content.title: GWW Q3 Deep Dive: Tariffs, LIFO Headwinds, and Strategic U.K. Exit Shape Guidance
content.summary: Maintenance and repair supplier W.W. Grainger (NYSE:GWW) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 6.1% year on year to $4.66 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $17.9 billion at the midpoint came in 0.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $10.21 per share was 2.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
